assumptions.choice: 20-bar Standard Deviation of close-to-close simple returns, computed as one Backtrader indicator line
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly permits choosing close-to-close returns rather than close and requires the choice to be stated.

assumptions.choice: Exit a long on any %K cross below %D and exit a short on any %K cross above %D
assumptions.reason: The specification says to exit on the opposite stochastic crossover signal without attaching the entry-only prior-bar threshold or volatility-direction filters to that exit.

assumptions.choice: Submit a separate stop order after the market entry fills, using the fill price and the contemporaneous ATR value
assumptions.reason: The stop distance is specified from the entry price, so the actual executed entry price is used once it is available.
